name: dqiv_vita
description: Dragon Quest IV (Android) native Unity-free port for PS Vita
long_description: A port of *Dragon Quest IV: Chapters of the Chosen (Android)* for the **PlayStation Vita**, based on the original ARMv7 game. Like FF3 Vita and FF6 Vita, it loads the Android game files instead of including them in the download. Everything the Unity engine did is reimplemented natively. You'll need your own copy of the game.
